name: Samuele
source:
Self centered, he's not easily upset by anything.

He's always been a ladies man, saying what he thinks with no stress has always been a great thing when it comes to getting girls, he's a natural.

His heart is kind of hardened due to the subconscious feeling of having been ripped apart from someone. He'll sometimes try to find excuses to avoid separating from his loved ones, and he's very reserved when talking about himself and his past.
